results.content: As investment in artificial intelligence has led to a boom in new data centers across the country, this week's Economist / YouGov Poll finds that many Americans oppose data center construction. About half (51%) of Americans say that the construction of new data centers is a bad thing for the country. Only 20% say it is a good thing while 17% say it is neither a good or bad thing.
